item.title: Executive function deficits not universal in alcohol use disorder
item.description: A study finds that executive function deficits are not universal in alcohol use disorder and may be less pronounced in treatment-naïve, higher-functioning patients.

item.title: First mRNA influenza vaccine outperforms standard-dose vaccination
item.description: The FLUENT phase 3 trial shows that mFlusiva, the first mRNA influenza vaccine approved in the US, provides 26.6% greater relative efficacy.

item.title: AI-based coronary calcium quantification identifies patients for lipid-lowering therapy
item.description: Hagopian and colleagues developed a deep-learning model to quantify coronary artery calcium on CT scans across Veterans Affairs hospitals.

item.title: Bicarbonate-buffered solution versus compound sodium lactate in abdominal surgery unclear
item.description: The trial did not establish non-inferiority of bicarbonate-buffered solution versus compound sodium lactate for end-of-surgery standard base excess.
